description: Edit a spec. Pass the version you read as expected_version; a stale version fails with version_conflict. Editing an approved spec republishes it: the version bumps and agents working on its tasks see spec_changed on their next heartbeat.

seq.description: Existing criterion number to replace; omit to add a new one

statement.description: Observable behaviour, worded so it can be tested

verify_ref.description: Test name, command, or review checklist item. Name the test when verify_kind is test

on_behalf_of.description: When a human explicitly asked you (an agent) to do this: their id, e.g. human:umit. You cannot approve a spec you authored

project.description: Project, needed only when a spec key exists in several projects

name: update_spec
title: Update Spec
